tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250tshe bdag lcags 'dra'i brgyud 'debs ni/1$0000300 kun bzang 'jam dpal 'jam dpal bshes gnyen dang*// o rgyan gtsug lag dpal dge bal po'i rgyal// gnubs chen gnubs kyi rigs byon drug

yon tan rgya mtsho/ ye shes rgya mtsho/ pad+ma dbang rgyal/ lha rje 'jam dpal/ rgya gar rdo rje/ chos kyi ye shes/ rnams la// gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ khro 'bar dar rgyas yang dag rdo rje dang*// phug pa sher rgyal rngog ston 'bum legs gro ston bsod 'bum blo gros rgyal// phag ston shāka mgon sbug ston chos kyi rgyal mtshan la// gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol// spang ston bde legs rgyal mtshan se ston rin chen rgyal mtshan spyan tshab mgon po zla ba nub dgon pa byams pa chos rgyal mtshan // byang bdag yab sras zur chen chos dbyings rang grol dang*// gong sa lnga pa zil gnon bzhad pa smin gling gter chen 'gyur med rdo rje la// gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol// rgyal sras pad 'gyur rin rnam khri rin rnam gsung sprul bde chen rdo rje pad dbang khri pad+ma dbang rgyal dang*/ khri chen sangs rgyas kun dga' yid dbang khri yid bzhin dbang rgyal blo mtha' yas kong sprul rin po che // zil gnon dgyes rtsal mi pham rgya mtsho rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol// zil gnon rtsa ba'i lha dang rgyan gyi lha// sprul pa rnam gsum gshed bzhi mon bdud dang*// 'chi bdag bcu gnyis sgo skyong dkyil 'khor lhar// gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol// tshe bdag gi brgyud 'debs dang*/ ༈ sman mchod lhan thabs su/ gong gi gsol ba 'debs so zhes pa'i mal du/ sman mchod 'bul lo mthu dbang dngos grub stsol// oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pañca a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes sgyur ro// 'gyur med rdo rjes bris pa'o// gong gi gter chen man chos kyi blo gros pas zhal bskang zhus pa'o/// /
